name: Bitwarden
description: Fills logins from your Bitwarden vault into login forms (Gecko's own autofill and login dropdown), pastes or copies them with Ctrl+Shift+L or :bw.exe, finds secure notes, cards and identities (:bw.exe find, :bw.exe notes), makes new passwords, usernames and forwarding addresses through DuckDuckGo, Firefox Relay, SimpleLogin, addy.io or Forward Email (:bw.exe generate, :bw.exe username, :bw.exe alias) and saves new logins (:bw.exe new), unlocks with a PIN, and signs in with passkeys kept there instead of Windows. Uses the Bitwarden command-line app (bw.exe).

settings.label: Where bw.exe is
settings.hint: Leave empty to find bw.exe on your PATH.

settings.label: Lock the vault after this many idle minutes
settings.hint: 0 keeps it unlocked until you close Breached or run :bw.exe lock.

settings.label: Unlocking with a PIN
settings.hint: After the master password, Bitwarden offers to set a PIN (:bw.exe pin changes it). The PIN is used when the vault has locked itself. Three wrong PINs turn it off.
options: Offer a PIN; the master password again after Breached restarts
Offer a PIN that also works after a restart (kept, locked, in your profile)

settings.label: Filling login forms
settings.hint: While the vault is unlocked, Breached's password manager uses its logins: a site's only login is filled in when the page loads, and clicking a login box lists them. Nothing is saved outside Bitwarden.
options: Fill in a site's only login, and list logins in login boxes
Only list logins when I click a login box

settings.label: Length of new passwords
settings.hint: For :bw.exe generate and :bw.exe new (5 to 128). :bw.exe generate 32 makes one of another length; :bw.exe generate words makes a passphrase.

settings.label: Your email address, for new usernames
settings.hint: When set, :bw.exe username and :bw.exe new suggest you+word1234@your.domain (plus addressing: the mail still reaches you). Leave empty for plain random usernames.

settings.label: Your own domain, for new usernames
settings.hint: If you get every address at your domain (catch-all), new usernames are word1234@your.domain. Used when the email address above is empty.

settings.label: Forwarding addresses from
settings.hint: For :bw.exe alias and :bw.exe new: a service that makes a new email address forwarding to you, as in Bitwarden's generator. The first use asks for its API key and keeps it in your vault as "Breached: <service> API key".

settings.label: Domain for forwarding addresses
settings.hint: addy.io: your addy.io domain (empty uses anonaddy.me). Forward Email: your domain (needed).

settings.label: Passkeys
settings.hint: Breached answers sites' passkey requests with the passkeys in your vault (loaded when you unlock it), and keeps new ones there. Off leaves passkeys to Windows Hello and security keys.
